# senv

> senv is an OpenEnv-compatible Echo environment server written in Rust. Each WebSocket session runs reset, step, and state on its own h5i-app MemoryEngine. It is not a Python environment manager and it is not an OS sandbox.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://senv.h5i.dev/): what the server is, and the 2026-11-09 client result.
- [Manual](https://senv.h5i.dev/manual/): `senv serve` flags, the Python EchoEnv snippet, limits.
- [Protocol](https://github.com/h5i-dev/senv/blob/main/PROTOCOL.md): the supported OpenEnv subset.
- [Design](https://github.com/h5i-dev/senv/blob/main/DESIGN.md): shell, kernel, and what a kernel proof would not establish.
- [Notice](https://github.com/h5i-dev/senv/blob/main/NOTICE): Apache-2.0 for senv and h5i-app; BSD-3-Clause for the OpenEnv behavior this server follows.

## Pins

- OpenEnv: `58d0344011fe961342706c90288f7e842b15b1c9` (meta-pytorch/OpenEnv).
- h5i-app: `5e0f8a929c57bb12a321090d98a14b3a2714b849`.

## Behavior that callers hit

- `senv serve` listens on `127.0.0.1:8000` unless `--bind` or `SENV_BIND` is set. `--env` is `echo` (default) or `wordle`.
- `EchoEnv` (production mode) posts `openenv/session/create` to `/mcp`, then opens `/ws?session_id=`.
- `reset`, `step`, and `state` are WebSocket messages. `list_tools` and `call_tool` are HTTP JSON-RPC and do not increment `step_count`.
- Reset reward is `0.0`, done is false, metadata message is `Echo environment ready!`.
- `echo_message` returns the message. `echo_with_length` returns `{message, length}` where length counts Unicode scalars.
- A WebSocket disconnect destroys that session. The official client ignores the following `session/close` error.
- Default cap is 8 sessions. Default max WebSocket message is 16 MiB. Unattached sessions idle out after 120 seconds.
- There is no `/reset`, `/step`, or `/state` HTTP API, no CORS, and no Gradio UI.

## Checked

On 2026-11-09, `scripts/echo_compat.sh` against the pinned unmodified client printed `PASS official EchoEnv reset/step/state, isolation, reconnect`. `scripts/wordle_compat.sh` printed `PASS official TextArenaEnv Wordle reset/step/state, feedback, win, invalid, isolation`. Wordle uses a system spelling list of 15,034 five-letter words, not NLTK and not the New York Times list, and its seeded secret is not CPython's RNG. `cargo test --locked --offline` passed 17 library tests, 3 Echo protocol tests, and 2 Wordle WebSocket tests. `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked --offline -- -D warnings` was clean. `proofs/SenvWordle.lean` proves the pure Wordle transition and does not prove socket isolation. `docs/BENCHMARKS.md` is one 2026-11-09 run of `scripts/bench.py` on one 4 vCPU host: senv Echo step mean 0.121 ms (n=400) and the pinned Python Echo server 2.097 ms; senv Wordle step mean 0.223 ms (n=240). The GPU was idle.
